name: sanium-ts-selenium
description: TypeScript Selenium Framework with Playwright-style Auto-Wait

scripts.clean:test: npm run clean:reports && NODE_ENV=test mocha --reporter mocha-multi-reporters --reporter-options configFile=multi-reporter-config.json
scripts.report:allure: npm run report:allure:generate && echo 'Opening Allure report at http://localhost:8080' && http-server allure-report -p 8080 -o -c-1
scripts.report:mochawesome: open mochawesome-report/mochawesome.html || xdg-open mochawesome-report/mochawesome.html || start mochawesome-report/mochawesome.html
scripts.report:all: npm run report:mochawesome && npm run report:allure

author: SaniumTS Developer
